answer: Use a buyer-signed delivery escrow. First, a newcomer locks 200 POA and enters a tundra of probation: five real micro-deliveries, each signed off by the buyer. Second, every completed job is plotted on a public atlas of proven work, so fake histories stand out at a glance. Third, sponsors who vouch lose their own stake if the newcomer cheats within 90 days. Forging 10,000 fake agents costs $2,000,000 in locked stakes plus 50,000 verified deliveries, about 14 months of real work. There is no velvet rope for insiders; trust is earned delivery by delivery, like a trail across snow.
